verdict.rationale: Intel's docs point to running the Gaudi Docker image and launching PyTorch training, distributed training, inference and model serving. These are scriptable, non-interactive workloads, which implies headless use. The evidence is only section headings, though, and never mentions CI pipelines or automation. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI documentation, CI runner or pipeline integration guidance, non-interactive automation examples, independent corroboration of CI use.
